title: Imagery / Illustration
slide_intent: Establish a primary visual language because repeated image-making choices help a brand feel familiar.
strategic_value: A recognizable illustration style and recurring characters can connect Duolingo communications to its product world.

practical_value: Begin new artwork with the illustration system and its dedicated guidance.
